description: We're a team of passionate engineering students excited to tackle NASA's Space Apps Challenge 2026! We love space tech, coding, and creative problem-solving, and we want to turn NASA's open data into something impactful. We're looking for teammates with skills in Python/data analysis, web or app development, UI/UX design, storytelling/presentation, or research. Beginners are welcome, since curiosity and teamwork matter most. Join us and let's build something out of this world!
summary:
🌙 LUNAR SPACE – Lunar Landing Site Navigator

Lunar Space is an advanced web-based lunar mission planning platform designed to help astronauts and researchers identify safe landing locations on the Moon.

Main Features

1. Live Date and Time
2. Lunar Weather and Environmental Conditions
3. Interactive 3D Earth and Moon Visualization
4. Rocket Launch and Landing Simulation
5. Fuel Consumption Prediction
6. Emergency Backup Planning
7. Lunar Landing Site Selection
8. Sun Elevation Angle Calculation
9. Moon Position Relative to Earth
10. Complete Mission Simulation

Technologies Used

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Three.js
- NASA APIs
- NASA Moon Trek
- JPL Horizons

Main Objective

To develop an intelligent lunar navigation system that helps users analyze lunar terrain, estimate fuel consumption, identify suitable landing locations and visualize complete lunar missions.

Project Vision

"Making lunar exploration smarter, safer and more intelligent through advanced visualization, scientific data and simulation."

LUNAR SPACE is a lunar mission planning and simulation platform designed to support future Moon exploration.
